entities.name: Vazozav
entities.description: Izzet League goblin Chief Observer, son of Joxotuxak, in service of Zomaj Hauc.

entities.name: Zomaj Hauc
entities.description: Izzet magelord who built the mana implosion bomb and later sought to harness trapped souls to control dragon eggs.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild of which Vazozav and Hauc are members.

entities.name: The Schism
entities.description: A spatial anomaly opened by the failed mana implosion bomb test that absorbs ghosts.

entities.name: The Cauldron
entities.description: Massive Izzet geothermal power dome powering Utvara.

entities.name: Crix
entities.description: Hauc's former experimental goblin aide who turned against him and saved Vazozav.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: Clans mostly killed by the implosion.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: Orzhov body with which Hauc had shadowy dealings.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: Guild with which Hauc had shadowy dealings.

events.summary: The first test of Hauc's mana implosion bomb fails to detonate as planned and opens the Schism; Vazozav survives while most nearby Gruul die.
events.quote: Vazozav survived the implosion, though most of the nearby Gruul Clans did not.

events.summary: Years later Vazozav maintains the Cauldron and grows skeptical of Hauc's erratic behavior and dealings.
events.quote: Vazozav remained skeptical of the magelord's increasingly erratic behavior

events.summary: Vazozav is caught in the destruction of the Cauldron during Hauc's final gambit and is saved by Crix, who turned against her creator.
events.quote: He was only saved thanks to the intervention of Crix
